args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions

trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary of what I did:

**Diagnosis:** The latest deploy of checkout-api (**v2.3.1**) was unhealthy in production, while the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api to v2.3.0 across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — rollout verified.
2. **Verified recovery** — service now reports healthy with an error rate of 0.2%.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident `INC-0001`** documenting the failing v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0 in all regions, and post-rollback health verification. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Next step for the team: investigate what broke in v2.3.1 before attempting a redeploy.
